name: Tridhya Tech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2018, Tridhya Tech Ltd is in the business of IT Solutions Developments & Maintenance Services and IT Staff Augmentation[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TTL offers comprehensive software development services, including all IT services and resources. The company provides turnkey consultancy across various industries such as e-commerce, real estate, transport and logistics, insurance, and others.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.87 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 113 to 82.1 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.30% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.8.39 Cr.
